strapiBlog.title: His Highness Rashid Al Maktoum Announces AED 100 Billion Zabeel District at DIFC
strapiBlog.short_description: Dubai is once again setting the stage for a monumental leap in the global financial sector. Vice President and Prime Minister of the UAE and Ruler of Dubai, His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, unveiled Phase Two of DIFC, Zabeel District, an AED 100 billion expansion plan.

data.text:
Dubai is once again setting the stage for a monumental leap in the global financial sector. Vice President and Prime Minister of the UAE and Ruler of Dubai, His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, unveiled the Zabeel District DIFC, an AED 100 billion ($27.23bn) expansion plan. 

The newly announced development is poised to strengthen the emirate’s position as a leading global financial hub, offering unparalleled opportunities for innovation and growth. 

Here is everything you need to know about the DIFC expansion news for 2026.

About the DIFC Zabeel District Project

The newly announced Zabeel project is a groundbreaking effort to elevate the Dubai International Financial Centre redevelopment to unprecedented heights. With a vast 17.7 million sq. ft. of space, this expansion will not only increase the district’s capacity but also reshape the way businesses and financial institutions operate in Dubai.

The DIFC Zabeel District project will offer state-of-the-art office spaces, residential areas, and a host of cutting-edge facilities designed to foster innovation, making it the ultimate destination for businesses looking to thrive in the new digital economy. 

This is a critical step in supporting DIFC’s growth into a global financial hub. Once completed, it will house over 42,000 companies and a workforce exceeding 125,000 people.

What Lies at the Heart of Dubai’s Finance Hub Makeover

At the core of this expansion lies an ambitious vision for DIFC’s future technologies hub, a dynamic space dedicated to fostering technological breakthroughs in the world of finance. 

More than one million sq. ft. will be devoted to a future technologies hub that will accommodate over 6,000 businesses and 30,000 tech specialists. This hub will be home to the world’s first purpose-built AI campus, designed to revolutionize artificial intelligence development and commercial innovation.

As part of the DIFC expansion news 2026, the Zabeel District project will also include a state-of-the-art Gaming & Immersive Technologies Hub, further enhancing Dubai’s position as a leader in innovation and digital development. 

The DIFC Dubai finance hub makeover will not only cater to the growing demand for business infrastructure but will also create an environment that fosters collaboration, creativity, and well-being. 

The district will feature expansive green spaces, wellness-focused amenities, and an integrated approach to work-life balance, making it an ideal destination for professionals, entrepreneurs, and families alike.

Key Highlights of the DIFC Expansion

Future Technologies Hub: Over one million square feet dedicated to cutting-edge technologies, including AI, blockchain, and digital transformation.
Innovation & Education: A world-class future technologies hub supporting over 6,000 businesses and 30,000 tech specialists, alongside top-tier educational facilities attracting global talent.

Cultural and Recreational Spaces: The addition of a new arts pavilion and wellness-focused amenities that integrate work and lifestyle. DIFC Zabeel District Project: A comprehensive development offering state-of-the-art office spaces, residential living, and world-class infrastructure.

Sustainability and Connectivity: A design philosophy focused on sustainability, green spaces, and easy access to the rest of Dubai.

FAQs

What does the DIFC Zabeel District project include?

The DIFC Zabeel District project includes futuristic office spaces, residential areas, educational institutions, and a dedicated future technologies hub to support the growth of businesses in Dubai.

What is the expected timeline for the DIFC expansion?

The first phase of the expansion will be completed in 2030, with the full DIFC makeover expected to be finished by 2040.

What industries will benefit from the DIFC expansion?

The expansion will benefit businesses across the financial, technology, education, and creative industries, providing world-class infrastructure and a thriving ecosystem for growth.
